title: @persona sitting in the driver's seat of a parked car, talking directly
content:
@persona sitting in the driver's seat of a parked car, talking directly
into a front-facing phone camera propped on the dashboard. Framed
chest-up, lens just below eye level, subtle handheld drift throughout.
She wears a fitted neutral crew-neck t-shirt, blonde hair braided over
one shoulder, minimal jewellery. She speaks fast and casually, like
she's mid-thought with a friend, eyebrows and mouth carrying most of the
expression, both hands rising into the bottom of frame to gesture and
dropping back out. Black leather interior, front headrests visible
behind her, street and green trees through the rear windows. Daylight
from the windshield falls unevenly across her face, rear windows
slightly blown out, no fill light, no reflector. Faint interior room
tone and distant traffic under the dialogue. One continuous handheld
take, no cuts, no camera moves, no colour grading, no studio lighting.

She leans slightly toward the lens on the first word and holds direct
eye contact. Small headshake on "nothing's changing". She sits back and
points down at her own part line, then drops the hand. Pace picks up,
both hands mime the nozzle motion, eyebrows raise on "twice a week".
She relaxes into a shrug and a small smile, holds eye contact on the
last line and goes still.

Dialogue: "Okay, I need to talk about this for a second. If you've been
putting serum in your hair and nothing's changing, it's probably not the
serum. It's where you're putting it. Most people coat the lengths and
skip the scalp completely, and the scalp is the part that actually grows
the hair. So this one has a nozzle that parts the hair and puts it
straight on the scalp. Rosemary, peptides, caffeine. Twice a week,
that's the whole routine. Link's below if you want it, but honestly,
whatever brand you're using, just start at the scalp. That's the whole
tip."

es.content:
@persona sentada en el asiento del conductor de un coche aparcado, hablando directamente
a la cámara frontal de un teléfono apoyado en el salpicadero. En plano
medio corto, con el objetivo justo por debajo del nivel de los ojos, con un
sutil vaivén de cámara en mano durante todo el tiempo. Lleva una camiseta
ajustada de cuello redondo en tono neutro, el pelo rubio trenzado sobre
un hombro, joyería mínima. Habla rápido y de forma casual, como si estuviera
pensando en voz alta con una amiga, con las cejas y la boca llevando la mayor
parte de la expresión; ambas manos suben al borde inferior del encuadre para
gesticular y vuelven a salir. Interior de cuero negro, reposacabezas delanteros
visibles detrás de ella, calle y árboles verdes a través de las ventanillas
traseras. La luz del día que entra por el parabrisas cae de forma desigual sobre
su rostro, las ventanillas traseras ligeramente sobreexpuestas, sin luz de relleno,
sin reflector. Un leve tono de ambiente interior y tráfico lejano bajo el diálogo.
Un solo plano continuo en cámara en mano, sin cortes, sin movimientos de cámara,
sin gradación de color, sin iluminación de estudio.

Se inclina ligeramente hacia el objetivo en la primera palabra y mantiene contacto
visual directo. Pequeño movimiento de cabeza en "nothing's changing". Se echa
hacia atrás y señala hacia abajo, a su propia línea de parte, y luego baja la mano.
El ritmo se acelera, ambas manos imitan el movimiento de la boquilla, las cejas
se levantan en "twice a week". Se relaja en un encogimiento de hombros y una
pequeña sonrisa, mantiene el contacto visual en la última línea y se queda quieta.

Diálogo: "Okay, I need to talk about this for a second. If you've been
putting serum in your hair and nothing's changing, it's probably not the
serum. It's where you're putting it. Most people coat the lengths and
skip the scalp completely, and the scalp is the part that actually grows
the hair. So this one has a nozzle that parts the hair and puts it
straight on the scalp. Rosemary, peptides, caffeine. Twice a week,
that's the whole routine. Link's below if you want it, but honestly,
whatever brand you're using, just start at the scalp. That's the whole
tip."

@persona assise au volant d’une voiture garée, parlant directement
dans la caméra frontale d’un téléphone posé sur le tableau de bord. Cadrage
buste, objectif juste sous le niveau des yeux, léger mouvement de main
tout au long de la prise. Elle porte un t-shirt ajusté à col rond, neutre,
ses cheveux blonds tressés sur une épaule, peu de bijoux. Elle parle vite
et naturellement, comme si elle réfléchissait à voix haute avec une amie,
les sourcils et la bouche portant l’essentiel de l’expression, les deux
mains remontant dans le bas du cadre pour gesticuler puis redescendant.
Intérieur en cuir noir, appuie-têtes avant visibles derrière elle, rue et
arbres verts à travers les vitres arrière. La lumière du jour venant du
pare-brise tombe de façon inégale sur son visage, vitres arrière légèrement
surexposées, sans lumière d’appoint, sans réflecteur. Léger bruit ambiant
de l’habitacle et circulation lointaine sous le dialogue. Une seule prise
continue à main levée, sans coupe, sans mouvement de caméra, sans étalonnage
des couleurs, sans éclairage de studio.

Elle se penche légèrement vers l’objectif sur le premier mot et maintient
un contact visuel direct. Petit hochement de tête sur « nothing’s changing ».
Elle se rassoit et pointe vers le bas en parlant de sa propre ligne, puis
laisse retomber la main. Le rythme s’accélère, les deux mains miment le
mouvement de la buse, les sourcils se lèvent sur « twice a week ». Elle se
détend dans un haussement d’épaules et un petit sourire, garde le contact
visuel sur la dernière ligne et reste immobile.

ja.content:
@persona が駐車中の車の運転席に座り、ダッシュボードに置いた前向きのスマホカメラに向かって सीधे話している。胸上のフレーミングで、レンズは目線よりわずかに下、全体を通してごくわずかな手持ちの揺れがある。彼女は体に沿うニュートラルなクルーネックTシャツを着ていて、ブロンドの髪は片方の肩に編み込まれ、アクセサリーは最小限。友達と話している途中のように、速く気軽に話し、表情の中心は眉と口元。両手がフレーム下部に上がってジェスチャーし、また外へ下がっていく。黒いレザーの内装、背後には前席のヘッドレストが見え、リアウィンドウ越しに通りと緑の木々が見える。フロントガラスからの昼光が顔にまだらに差し込み、リアウィンドウはやや白飛び気味。フィルライトなし、レフ板なし。会話の下には、かすかな車内のルームトーンと遠くの交通音。1本の連続した手持ちショットで、カットなし、カメラ移動なし、カラーグレーディングなし、スタジオ照明なし。

最初の一言で少しレンズに身を乗り出し、まっすぐアイコンタクトを保つ。"nothing's changing" のところで小さく首を振る。いったん背もたれに寄りかかって、自分の担当セリフを指さし、その手を下ろす。テンポが上がり、両手でノズルの動きを真似し、"twice a week" で眉を上げる。最後の一文では肩をすくめて少し笑い、アイコンタクトを保ったまま静止する。

Rosemary, peptides, caffeine. Twice a week, that's the whole routine. Link's below if you want it, but honestly, whatever brand you're using, just start at the scalp. That's the whole tip."

ko.content:
@persona가 주차된 차의 운전석에 앉아, 대시보드 위에 올려둔 전면 카메라 폰을 향해 직접 말한다. 프레임은 가슴 위까지 잡히고, 렌즈는 눈높이보다 약간 아래에 있으며, 전반적으로 미세한 핸드헬드 드리프트가 있다. 그녀는 몸에 맞는 뉴트럴 톤 크루넥 티셔츠를 입고, 금발 머리를 한쪽 어깨로 땋아 내렸으며, 액세서리는 거의 없다. 친구와 대화하듯 생각이 이어지는 중간처럼 빠르고 자연스럽게 말하며, 표정은 주로 눈썹과 입으로 드러난다. 두 손이 프레임 아래쪽으로 올라와 제스처를 했다가 다시 내려간다. 검은 가죽 인테리어, 앞좌석 헤드레스트가 뒤로 보이고, 뒷창 너머로는 거리와 푸른 나무가 보인다. 앞유리로 들어오는 낮빛이 얼굴에 고르지 않게 비치고, 뒷창은 약간 하얗게 날아가 있으며, 보조 조명도 반사판도 없다. 대사 아래로는 희미한 실내 룸톤과 먼 차량 소리가 깔린다. 컷 없이 이어지는 단일 핸드헬드 테이크, 카메라 무브 없음, 컬러 그레이딩 없음, 스튜디오 조명 없음.

첫 단어에서 렌즈 쪽으로 살짝 몸을 기울이며 직접적인 아이컨택을 유지한다. "nothing's changing"에서 고개를 작게 젓는다. 몸을 뒤로 기대고 자신의 파트 라인을 가리킨 뒤 손을 내린다. 말의 속도가 빨라지고, 두 손으로 노즐 동작을 흉내 내며 "twice a week"에서 눈썹이 올라간다. 마지막 줄에서는 어깨를 으쓱하고 작은 미소를 지으며 아이컨택을 유지한 채 가만히 멈춘다.

Dialogue: "Okay, I need to talk about this for a second. If you've been putting serum in your hair and nothing's changing, it's probably not the serum. It's where you're putting it. Most people coat the lengths and skip the scalp completely, and the scalp is the part that actually grows the hair. So this one has a nozzle that parts the hair and puts it straight on the scalp. Rosemary, peptides, caffeine. Twice a week, that's the whole routine. Link's below if you want it, but honestly, whatever brand you're using, just start at the scalp. That's the whole tip."

atrás dela, rua e árvores verdes pelas janelas traseiras. A luz do dia
vinda do para-brisa cai de forma desigual sobre o rosto dela, janelas traseiras
levemente estouradas, sem fill light, sem refletor. Leve som ambiente do interior e tráfego distante sob o diálogo. Um único take contínuo em handheld,
sem cortes, sem movimentos de câmera, sem color grading, sem iluminação de estúdio.

as duas mãos imitam o movimento do bico aplicador, as sobrancelhas sobem em "twice a week".

última linha e fica imóvel.

@persona 坐在一辆停着的车的驾驶座上，直接对着支在仪表台上的前置手机摄像头说话。画面为胸部以上构图，镜头略低于眼平线，全程有轻微的手持漂移。她穿着一件合身的中性圆领 T 恤，金发编成辫子搭在一侧肩上，佩戴极少的首饰。她说话很快、很随意，就像正和朋友聊到一半时突然想到什么，主要靠眉眼和嘴部传达情绪；双手会抬到画面下方做手势，然后又落回画外。黑色皮革内饰，前排头枕在她身后可见，后窗外能看到街道和绿色树木。来自挡风玻璃的日光不均匀地落在她脸上，后窗略微过曝，没有补光，没有反光板。对话下方能听到轻微的车内环境声和远处的车流声。全程一个连续的手持镜头，没有剪辑，没有镜头运动，没有调色，没有棚拍灯光。

她在第一个词时微微向镜头前倾，并保持直接眼神接触。说到“nothing's changing”时轻轻摇头。随后她靠回去，指向自己那句台词的位置，然后把手放下。语速加快时，两只手模仿喷嘴的动作，说到“twice a week”时眉毛抬起。最后她放松下来，耸了耸肩，露出一点微笑，在最后一句保持眼神接触，然后静止不动。

对白："Okay, I need to talk about this for a second. If you've been putting serum in your hair and nothing's changing, it's probably not the serum. It's where you're putting it. Most people coat the lengths and skip the scalp completely, and the scalp is the part that actually grows the hair. So this one has a nozzle that parts the hair and puts it straight on the scalp. Rosemary, peptides, caffeine. Twice a week, that's the whole routine. Link's below if you want it, but honestly, whatever brand you're using, just start at the scalp. That's the whole tip."
